# routeros_disk_btrfs_subvolume (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_disk_btrfs_subvolume" "subvolume" {
  fs   = "example"
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fs` (String) The label of the Btrfs file system that holds this subvolume.
- `name` (String) Name of the subvolume.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `mount` (Boolean) Whether the subvolume is mounted automatically.
- `mountpoint` (String) The path the subvolume is made available at when `mount` is enabled.
- `parent` (String) The parent subvolume. Setting it creates a snapshot of that subvolume instead of an empty subvolume.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Makes the subvolume immutable. Has to be set to `yes` on the source subvolume when creating snapshots that are going to be sent to another device.

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) The moment the subvolume was created.
- `dead` (Boolean) Whether the subvolume has been deleted and is only waiting to be cleaned up.
- `default` (Boolean) It's the default item.
- `fullname` (String) The full path of the subvolume inside the Btrfs file system.
- `generation` (String) The Btrfs generation the subvolume was last modified in.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mounted` (Boolean) Whether the subvolume is currently mounted.
- `path` (String) The path of the subvolume relative to the top level of the Btrfs file system.
- `received_uuid` (String) The UUID of the source subvolume when this subvolume was created by a receive transfer.
- `recv_time` (String) The moment the subvolume was received from another device.
- `recv_trans_id` (String) The Btrfs transaction id of the receive operation.
- `send_time` (String) The moment the subvolume was last sent to another device.
- `send_trans_id` (String) The Btrfs transaction id of the send operation.
- `snapshot` (Boolean) Whether this subvolume is a snapshot of another subvolume.
- `snapshots` (String) The snapshots taken from this subvolume.
- `subvolume_id` (String) The Btrfs internal subvolume id.
- `top_level` (String) The id of the subvolume this subvolume is nested in.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the subvolume.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/disk/btrfs/subvolume get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_disk_btrfs_subvolume.subvolume "*1"
```
